# CureMD

> CureMD is a comprehensive cloud-based healthcare IT platform offering integrated EHR, practice management, revenue cycle management, and AI-powered solutions for medical practices of all sizes.

CureMD provides end-to-end healthcare solutions including electronic health records, billing automation, telemedicine, specialty-specific workflows, and advanced AI features like medical scribe and contact center automation. The platform serves diverse healthcare organizations from independent practices to FQHCs and public health agencies.

## Key Topics

- EHR (Electronic Health Records)
- Practice Management
- Revenue Cycle Management
- Medical Billing
- Patient Portal
- AI Medical Scribe
- Mobile EHR (Avalon)
- Clinical Documentation
- HIPAA Compliance
- Specialty EHR
- Healthcare Automation
- Cloud-Based Solution
- Claims Management
- Patient Engagement
- ICD-10 Coding

## Core Platform Solutions

- [Most Affordable EHR, RCM & PM For Any Size of Practice](https://www.curemd.com): CureMD homepage showcasing cloud-based EHR, telemedicine, and medical billing solutions
- [CureMD's All in One EHR, PM and Billing Solution](https://www.curemd.com/all-in-one.asp): All-in-one integrated EHR, practice management, and billing platform
- [#1 EHR (Electronic Health Records) - Easy To Use & Intuitive](https://www.curemd.com/ehr.asp): Cloud-based EHR with e-prescribing, lab integration, and workflow automation
- [Practice Management System - Put Your Practice on Track](https://www.curemd.com/practice-management.asp): Award-winning practice management software for scheduling, billing, and claims
- [Revenue Cycle Management Services — RCM Services](https://www.curemd.com/revenue-cycle-management-services.asp): AI-powered revenue cycle management and billing automation services

## Specialty & Advanced Solutions

- [Specialty EHR Tailored to Match Your Clinical Needs](https://www.curemd.com/specialty-ehr): Specialty EHR supporting 30+ medical specialties with AI-powered documentation
- [AI Medical Scribe | CureMD's Voice-to-Note Solution](https://www.curemd.com/ai-medical-scribe): Voice-to-note AI scribe for clinical documentation and medical coding
- [AI-Powered Patient Contact Center for Medical Practices](https://www.curemd.com/ai-contact-center): AI contact center for patient scheduling, appointments, and insurance verification
- [Transform Your Practice with AI Empowered EHR Solution](https://www.curemd.com/accelerating-artificial-intelligence-in-healthcare.asp): AI-powered EHR with disease prediction and clinical decision support tools
- [Care Management Software Doctors Wish They Used Earlier](https://www.curemd.com/chronic-care-management-software.asp): Chronic care management software with patient engagement and billing automation

## Mobile & Patient Engagement

- [#1 iPad & iPhone EHR and PM - CureMD](https://www.curemd.com/avalon.asp): Mobile EHR and practice management app for iPad and iPhone devices
- [CureMD Patient Portal](https://www.curemd.com/patient-portal.asp): Secure patient portal with appointment requests, lab results, and wearable integration

## Specialized Healthcare Services

- [Community & Public Health Services and Solution](https://www.curemd.com/public-health): EHR and billing solutions for FQHC and public health organizations
- [Medical Credentialing Services for Physician & Providers](https://www.curemd.com/medical-credentialing-services): Physician credentialing and provider enrollment services with compliance automation
